page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred lines in red and black, a woodcut vignette in the middle, imprint below. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Ex ore quondam Magni Theologi D.
TICIS rudi Minervâ exceptum: ac postea crebris Editio-
POSTHVMAM hanc EDITIONEM juxta vltimum Patris
[woodcut vignette: framed scene with inscription "FATVIAM ... INVENIENT"]

page.notes: Woodcut vignette in the centre, inscription partly legible only ("FATVIAM", "INVENIENT"). A violet library stamp at right and a handwritten pen stroke near "Ursini" are not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse is visible faintly and omitted.
